stem.text: A battery of negligible internal resistance may be connected between any two points P, Q, R and S of the network of resistors shown.

stem.alt: Network of four resistors forming a square loop with corners labelled P (upper left), Q (upper right), R (lower right) and S (lower left). Resistors of 6.0 ohm (left side), 3.0 ohm (top), 5.0 ohm (right side) and 4.0 ohm (bottom).

stem.text: Which connections will give the largest current and the smallest current in the battery?
